relations: The flickering flame's varying height and width modulate the orange glow's brightness and position on the wood panel behind it.
As the flame tip shifts and reshapes between pointed and rounded forms, the cast glow drifts slightly in sync.
The pale cream candle body, curled black wick, white dish, and wooden background remain fixed while the flame changes.
Burning continues without visible wax shortening, so the flame's motion stems from flicker rather than structural change.
caption: The video captures a lit pale cream taper candle standing slightly tilted in a shallow white oval dish on a wooden surface, set against a vertical wood-paneled wall. A short curled black wick crowns the candle. It supports a single flame that leans to the right and casts an orange glow onto the panel behind it. The flame flickers continuously, shifting between tall, narrow, pointed shapes and shorter, broader, rounded ones, with its tip moving position. The orange glow on the wood brightens, dims, and drifts slightly with these flickers. The candle body, wick, dish, and background remain essentially fixed, while the camera holds largely steady with only minor handheld jitter. No measurable shortening or deformation of the wax is visible, and the burning process is already underway and still continuing.
